newsitem.title: USA: Extended Stay opens four new properties.
newsitem.headline: Extended Stay opens four new properties.

text.p: Extended Stay America Inc said on Friday that four new properties were opened in the month of December, bringing its total of properties to 40.
The hotel chain surpassed its earlier estimate of 33 operating locations by the end of December 1996, the company said.
As of December 31, 1996, the company also had 50 properties under construction in 26 states and options to buy 106 sites for development in 30 states, the company said.
The company's properties are designed to appeal to value-conscious guests on visits of a week or longer with each room having a refrigerator, a microwave, utensils and a recliner.
Depending on the geographical location, rooms usually rent for between $189 and $299 per week, Extended Stay said.
